title: Medicine prices connections
description: Sort 16 words from the video on medicine prices into four groups.

groups.name: Medicine and the patient
groups.explanation: Words about the medicine itself and how it is used.

groups.name: Who is in the chain
groups.explanation: Companies that make, move or pay for medicines.

groups.name: Paying for medicines
groups.explanation: Words about prices and who pays.

groups.name: Patents and brands
groups.explanation: Words about who can make a medicine and under what name.
